Inkpad 只申请了“访问自己创建的文件”这一项权限，所以你在 Google:
Inkpad asks only for permission to see the files it created itself, so a folder you made by hand in Google Drive is invisible to it, and entering that folder’s ID makes the sync fail. To keep the notes inside another folder:

1. Leave “Folder ID” above empty and sync once. Inkpad creates a folder named “Inkpad” at the top of My Drive.

2. Press “Open in browser” beside “Folder synced with” and, in Google Drive, move that “Inkpad” folder (drag it, or right click → Move) into the folder you want. Moving does not change its ID, and nothing needs changing on this device.

3. On your other devices, enter the ID shown under “Folder synced with” as the “Folder ID”; or press “Export credentials as JSON…” here and use “Import from a JSON credentials file…” there, which carries the folder ID along.

Note: the other devices must use the same client ID and secret and the same Google account, or they cannot see the folder either. If you change “Folder ID” later, this device backs every notebook up again to the new folder, and the other devices need the same ID.
